title: Senior Safety Database Administrator
description:
Join Excelya, where Audacity, Care, and Energy define who we are and how we work. We believe in creating bold solutions and fostering an inclusive environment where collaboration and individual growth go hand in hand.

We are looking for a Senior Oracle Argus Safety Consultant to play a key role in maintaining, optimizing, and shaping the future of a global pharmacovigilance platform, while acting as a trusted partner to business, compliance, and technical stakeholders.

Key responsibilities :

  • Manage and maintain advanced Oracle Argus Safety configurations, including products, licenses, studies, reporting destinations, agreements, and system parameters.
  • Design, configure, test, and document complex regulatory reporting rules, including the use of SQL-based logic and advanced reporting conditions.
  • Oversee E2B message flows and mappings, ensuring compliant data exchanges, successful testing, and reliable submission processes.
  • Act as the functional expert for business requirements analysis, translating regulatory and operational needs into robust, compliant system configurations.
  • Perform end-to-end investigations to identify root causes of system, data, or reporting discrepancies and assess associated business and compliance risks.
  • Lead change management and validation activities, including impact assessments, test strategy definition, user acceptance criteria, and regression testing.
  • Provide expert support for complex incidents, collaborate with business, IT, vendors, and PV stakeholders, and proactively manage risks impacting compliance or operational continuity.
  • Support the strategic Argus reconfiguration project, contributing to target-state design, gap analysis, functional architecture decisions, migration planning, and transition readiness.

Requirements

At Excelya, we encourage taking daring steps, so we seek individuals who are ready to advance with our mission and embody our values.

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy
  • Experience: Strong experience with Oracle Argus Safety in a functional administration, system expert, or business analyst role within a pharmaceutical company, biotech, or CRO environment. Proven experience managing complex Argus configurations in a GxP-regulated environment.
  • Skills: Advanced expertise in Oracle Argus Safety configuration, regulatory reporting rules, E2B message flows and mappings, system troubleshooting, impact assessments, testing, and change management. Ability to translate business and regulatory requirements into compliant, scalable, and maintainable system solutions. Strong stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge : Solid understanding of global Pharmacovigilance processes, international regulatory requirements, E2B standards, GxP compliance, data integrity, and computerized system validation principles.
  • Languages: Fluent in English; additional languages are considered an asset.

Benefits

Why Join Us?

At Excelya, we combine passion for science with enthusiasm for teamwork to redefine excellence in healthcare.

Here's what makes us unique

We are a young, ambitious health company representing 900 Excelyates, driven to become Europe's leading mid-size CRO with the best employee experience. Our one-stop provider service model offering full-service, functional service provider, and consulting enables you to evolve through diverse projects. Working alongside preeminent experts, you will help improve scientific, operational, and human knowledge to enhance the patient's journey.

Excelling with care means benefiting from an environment that values your natural talents, pushes boundaries with audacity, and nurtures your potential, allowing you to contribute fully to our shared mission.

title: Senior/Staff Evaluation Data Analyst (Agentic Search)
Senior/Staff Evaluation Data Analyst (Agentic Search)
Data Analyst
description:
Help launch our new temping product and drive commercial impact!

At YoungOnes, data is at the start of every decision. Our Data & RevOps team has a seat at every table and takes a leading role in where the company goes next. Two years ago we rebuilt our data environment in Databricks from scratch, and it is fully ready for the future. There are few better environments to work in.

We are looking for a Data Analyst with a focus on product, who also supports our marketing and commercial teams with deeper analyses. Someone with experience who is ready to take responsibility, and who does not stop at a report but actively steers on the outcome.

What will you do?

Your main focus is product. Next to that, you support marketing and the commercial teams, which keeps your work varied.

Product

In the flexible work market, companies used to choose between temping (uitzenden) and freelancers. Since last year we have been bringing a new proposition to market that sits in between: non-service temping. It combines the legal certainty of temping with the flexibility and personal control of freelancing, all through our platform. This is an important step in our strategy towards one app for work.

  • Take the lead in tracking the progress of this new proposition;

  • Define the KPIs and funnel that show whether the proposition is working;

  • Analyse the full journey of workers and clients, from onboarding to repeat shifts;

  • Spot problems early and actively steer where you see them;

  • Translate insights into concrete improvements together with product and development;

  • Work in a select team that operates as a startup within the company.

Commercial & marketing support

Next to product, you are the analytical sparring partner for our commercial teams and marketing. You go beyond the standard reports and dive deeper when questions get complex.

  • Deliver deeper analyses for the commercial teams, for example on client potential, retention and growth opportunities;

  • Support marketing with insight into campaign results and ROAS.

This role is diverse, but above all it gives you a lot of freedom to take initiative and make an impact.

Your team

You will join an effective Data & RevOps team with 3 Analysts, 2 Engineers, a Performance Manager and 2 Process aAnalysts. You report to the Head of Data.

The data itself is interesting: we support a two sided marketplace with workers on one side and clients on the other. AI is built into the design of how we work and makes the technical side of your job more simple. We use Genie within Databricks, which fully understands our data environment, Claude to connect multiple systems, and Gemini for quick support on smaller tasks.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has at least 3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst or Commercial Analyst;

  • Has experience tracking and steering product performance, and/or with commercial or marketing analytics;

  • Is strong in SQL and familiar with Python/PySpark and a visualisation tool such as Power BI or Amplitude;

  • Has experience with Databricks, or is eager to work in it;

  • Uses AI tooling naturally to work faster and smarter;

  • Takes ownership and dares to make choices and influence stakeholders;

  • Communicates clearly with both technical and non technical colleagues;

  • Is already residing in the Netherlands and is allowed to work in the country and speaks fluent English (Dutch is a plus);

We are not looking for someone who only delivers reports. We want someone who takes the lead, sees problems before others do and makes sure something is done about them.

What do we offer?

  • A gross salary between €4,300 and €6,100 based on full-time employment;

  • 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek;

  • 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance;

  • We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp;

  • Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, biweekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months, sport tournaments, and much more;

  • A leading role in a new proposition that is key to our strategy;

  • One of the best data environments to work in, with Databricks and AI built in;

  • A company that is truly data driven, where your insights shape decisions;

  • A high level of autonomy, freedom and responsibility.

YoungOnes is a place where you learn fast, build fast and see results fast. Ready to take the lead? Then we would love to hear from you.

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: AI & Data Analytics Partner
description:
About Jimdo

We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses.

Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world.

We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward.

At the heart of Jimdo is a strong belief in personalized, data-driven guidance. Our platform combines design, business tools, and an AI-powered core that turns real customer data into clear insights and next steps helping our customers focus on what moves their business forward.

Role Overview:

Jimdo is becoming an AI-first company, and our People team is one of the first places where that shows up in daily work. We're looking for an AI & Data Analytics Partner to build the agents, analytics and workflow automations that make the People team faster, smarter and easier to scale.

You'll take a process from "this is slow and manual" to a working, compliant solution in production, and then make sure the team can run and extend it without you. You'll also give leadership one reliable view of People data, so decisions rest on numbers everyone trusts.

You’ll start with the People team, and the scope can grow to any other function across Jimdo.

The team and who you'll work with:

You'll report to the Manager Performance Intelligence and work day to day with the People team and our HR Business Partners.

You'll also work closely with our AI team on standards and capabilities, with Finance and Legal on data consistency and compliance, and with our HR system and payroll providers.

This is a remote role, open to candidates based in Germany, Italy, Spain or Portugal.

What you'll be doing:

  • Build a central reporting suite in Tableau that brings data from HiBob, payroll and compensation tools into one source of truth, with dashboards leadership actually uses.

  • Own the quality and structure of People data, and use analytics to spot workforce trends, risks and process bottlenecks.

  • Find the HR processes with the most friction and fix them with AI agents and workflow automation, from first prototype to production.

  • Improve self-service for employees and managers with AI tools that answer the repetitive questions, so the People team can focus on the work that needs a person.

  • Connect our systems of record and improve the data flow between HR and Finance, so there's far less manual reconciliation.

  • Make every solution auditable, explainable and compliant, and set clear guardrails for responsible AI use.

  • Run hands-on workshops and co-building sessions and write playbooks, so the team can build and maintain automations on their own.

Your first months:

  • After 3 months: you know our People systems and data flows, you've agreed the reporting scope with the People team, and your first quick-win automation is live.

  • After 6 months: the central reporting suite is in use by leadership, and at least one AI-enabled HR process runs in production

What you bring to the table:

  • 5+ years in data analytics, AI and automation, or technical systems roles.

  • 2+ years of hands-on work with LLMs, agents, prompt engineering and workflow orchestration tools such as n8n, with solutions you've taken into production.

  • A track record of improving business processes through automation or system redesign, with results you can show.

  • Strong data analysis skills and expert-level Tableau: you build dashboards that turn complex data into clear recommendations. Database knowledge is a plus.

  • Expert knowledge of HiBob as a user, including its data and reporting, and a solid sense of data privacy and compliance (GDPR) when handling sensitive people data.

  • You enjoy teaching: you explain technical choices in plain language and measure your success by how well others can use what you've built.

Nice to have

  • Direct experience in an HR or People Operations team.

  • A certification in AI, machine learning, analytics or automation.

  • Experience working with Finance, Legal or external HR service providers.

What we offer:

Inspiring Mission: At our core, we are driven by a meaningful mission - to  empower solopreneurs and small businesses to succeed and  to contribute to the sustainability and vibrancy of the communities they serve.

Flexibility and Trust: Our work environment thrives on flexibility and trust. We offer fully remote work set-up  with opportunities for in-person collaboration. You can manage your working hours flexibly because we prioritize the results you deliver over the number of hours you put in. 

An International Diverse Team: Our team is a mosaic of over 248 individuals hailing from 50+ different countries and working across 15+ diverse locations. We take pride in our openness and inclusivity.

Continuous  Growth and Career Development: We invest in your growth with company-wide access to LinkedIn Learning and curated learning paths. From day one, you have the chance to contribute your ideas and create a meaningful impact. Our flat hierarchies and swift decision-making processes provide an open platform for your career progression.

Competitive Benefits Package: 

  • Annual compensation reviews to ensure you're rewarded fairly.

  • A remote office set-up bonus to enhance your workspace.

  • An employee assistance program, offering resources and counseling.

  • Plus, a perk that keeps giving: up to three free Jimdo websites for your personal or professional projects that you get to keep forever.

This means that we don’t discriminate based on race or ethnic origin, color, the language(s) you speak, where you (or your parents) are from, or whether or not you consider yourself to have a disability.
